newsitem.title: USA: SEC narrows focus in municipal bond probe - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SEC narrows focus in municipal bond probe - WSJ.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission has narrowed the focus of its investigation into municipal-bond market abuses, the Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The report said the SEC is concentrating on about two dozen bond deals sold in the early 1990s, but has not discarded its probe into other deals, which numbered as many as 100.
The probe covers the sale of bond deals known as advanced refundings. Firms under investigation include Merrill Lynch & Co, Travelers Group's Smith Barney Inc and PaineWebber Group's PaineWebber Inc.
